question: What contemplative visualization grants the power to shake the triple world?
premises: A smoky-colored appearance is to be contemplated.
The contemplation is to be done continually.
Shaking the triple world is stated as the resulting power.
inference: Therefore, by continually contemplating a smoky-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
uncertainties: The object visualized as smoke-colored is not explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
